entry_hint: Double-click an entry to view or edit it
saved_hint: Changes are saved in your encrypted vault
empty: Your vault is empty. Add your first entry.
save_failed_body: Check folder permissions and free disk space. Your previous entries are unchanged. The form will reopen with your input.
welcome_hint: Choose your language and theme. You can change them later in Settings.
settings_error: Could not save settings. Check access to the data folder.
settings_invalid: The settings file is invalid. Choose your language and theme again. Your password vault is unchanged.
create_hint: Choose a long passphrase (at least 12 characters). A forgotten master password cannot be recovered.
unlock_hint: Enter your master password to access your entries.
vault_exists: A vault already exists. Restart the app.
unlock_error: Incorrect master password or a damaged vault.
format_error: The vault structure is damaged or unsupported.
file_error: Could not open the file. Check access to the data folder.
reset_body: This deletes the local vault and all its entries on this computer. The app cannot undo this. You can then create an empty vault with a new master password. Separate backup copies are not deleted.
reset_error: Could not delete the vault. Check file permissions. No new vault was created.
location_error: Could not open the application data folder.
lock_error: Vault may already be open. Close the other instance. Otherwise, check access to the data folder.
select_hint: Its username and password will appear here.
generator_hint: A random password, or a phrase that is easier to type.
generator_privacy: Generated on your device. Never sent anywhere.
phrase_hint: Independently chosen English words. 8 words recommended.
invalid_website: Enter an HTTPS address, such as https://example.com.
delete_entry_body: Delete this entry? This cannot be undone.
backup_saved: Encrypted backup saved. Your current master password is needed to open it.
backup_imported: Added {count} entries. Existing entries were kept.
backup_error: Import failed. Check the password, file and vault permissions.
chrome_connected: Connection installed. Open the Vault extension in Chrome.
chrome_error: Could not connect Chrome. Check the extension ID and the native-host folder beside the app.
about_body: Local password manager. No account, telemetry or cloud sync. First public beta; not independently security-audited.
browser_access_body: Allow the extension to access accounts for {origin} until the vault locks?
